definitions.explanation: the characteristic scenery of winter — bare trees, snow, cold skies, and a stark atmosphere

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{冬景色|ふゆげしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I gaze at the winter scenery from the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われた→覆う：02020_oou⟧{冬景色|ふゆげしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The snow-covered winter landscape is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車窓|しゃそう}→車窓：15504_shasou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{冬景色|ふゆげしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{趣|おもむき}→趣：09072_omomuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The winter scenery seen from the train window has a completely different charm from summer.

notes:
A compound noun combining ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧ (winter) with ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧ (scenery). The initial k of ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧ voices to g (rendaku) in this compound. Evokes a poetic, aesthetic appreciation of winter's sparse beauty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冬景色|ふゆげしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: winter scenery spreads out
- ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冬景色|ふゆげしき}: winter scenery as far as the eye can see
- {冬景色|ふゆげしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy winter scenery

RELATED SEASONAL COMPOUNDS:
- {春景色|はるげしき}: spring landscape
- {夏景色|なつげしき}: summer landscape
- {秋景色|あきげしき}: autumn landscape

CULTURAL NOTE:
{冬景色|ふゆげしき} is also the title of a famous Japanese song (⟦{唱歌|しょうか}→唱歌：21282_shouka⟧) taught in schools, celebrating the quiet beauty of a winter morning. The word carries literary and nostalgic associations beyond its literal meaning.
